title: Resolve a relative template path from the main checkout
goal: check-harness and reconcile-preview find the same template from the main checkout and from any worktree.
acceptance: A committed test fails before the fix for a worktree under .claude/worktrees/<name>
An absolute path, ~ and HARNESS_HOME behave as before
Outside a Git repository a relative path resolves from the project root
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-13: one path helper in two tools and a regression test.
